name: maybe_Fs_Archive_OpenRecordByPath
signature: u32 maybe_Fs_Archive_OpenRecordByPath(void* self, u32* out, int* typeAndIndex)
summary: Resolves a UTF-16 archive path, hashes it (seed 0x075BCD15, rotate-xor), looks the entry up with Fs_Archive_FindFile (retrying as directory on 0x11/0x6F), then allocates a 0x30-byte accessor node and fills offset/size/owner.
evidence: Callees are exactly Fs_Archive_ResolvePath/Fs_Archive_FindFile/Fs_Archive_FindDirectory/Mem_PoolAllocNode and the sole caller is Fs_CacheSet_UpdateEntries; the hash seed 0x075BCD15 and the 0x11/0x6F retry are visible. However the body is a damaged decompilation (flag-register/rotate idioms, local_74/local_78 pointer arithmetic, truncated tail), so the name stays maybe_ at low confidence.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateCameraAndAnimB
signature: u32 maybe_Field_Actor_UpdateCameraAndAnimB(FieldActor* actor, u32 arg2, int arg3)
summary: Damaged-prologue vfunc that sets up the camera projection from the scene node, checks the actor's active flag and runs Field_NpcUpdateMoveAnimation; argument list not recovered.
evidence: unaff_r4/unaff_r6 in prologue mean args are not recovered; named callees Camera_SetupProjection, Field_NpcUpdateMoveAnimation, Field_SceneNode_GetPosition only show it is a field-actor camera/anim update.

name: maybe_Camera_FindVisiblePathEntry
summary: Searches the camera's 16-entry path table for an entry whose expanded box contains the reference point and whose path node passes the visibility chain, returning the camera work's path pointer at +0x15CC.
evidence: Caller maybe_Camera_UpdateFollowPosition_2; body uses +0x15CC camera path field; halt_baddata blocks truncate control flow so exact semantics uncertain.

name: Ui_CollectObjectsByMask
summary: Scans the global UI object list, appends every object carrying flag bits 0x40000040 whose class-marker chain reaches 0x007C503C, hiding each and storing it in out->f_18.
evidence: Constants 0x40000040 and 0x007C503C inside body; callers Actor_Action_UpdateState, Ui_ScreenSlideAnim_Start, Ui_SceneWindow_Open; callees Ui_ObjectList_Begin/End.

name: maybe_Ui_ScreenChild_Ctor_77E254
summary: Constructor of one of the fifteen child objects built by Ui_ScreenController_InitChildren: chains Ui_MotionPath_Ctor, installs vtable 0x0077E254, clears ~0x38 state words and chains four 0x004B65C0 sub-objects.
evidence: Vtable 0x0077E254 shares Camera_Field_Delete (+0x04) and Camera_Field_Update (+0x10) with field-camera vtable 0x0077E258, so camera-related, but exact class unresolved.

name: Ui_TextScreen_Ctor_77E564
summary: Constructor of a screen object with a text cache: chains Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache, installs vtable 0x77E564, sets -1/0 defaults at +0xC98/+0xC99, initialises the text-line cache at +0xCA4 and clears the six-word block and two flag bytes.
evidence: Named callees Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache, Ui_TextLineCache_InitAndReturn, FieldParty_ResetMemberSlot; caller Field_ObjectFactory_Kind14; concrete screen class not identified.

name: Item_IsAnyRequiredItemElsewhere
signature: u32 maybe_Item_IsAnyRequiredItemElsewhere(u32 self, RecipeRow* row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Menu-condition test over a record's four required item ids: for each non-0xFFFF id, if a storage instance exists but the default-storage lookup resolves to a different instance, return 1.
evidence: Single caller Ui_MenuCondition_Evaluate in kind-0 branch; four-id row layout at +0x12/+0x14/+0x16/+0x18; callees Item_GetStoragePointer, Item_CountEquipped, Game_GetWork.

name: maybe_Item_AreRequiredItemsOwned
signature: u32 maybe_Item_AreRequiredItemsOwned(u32 self, RecipeRow* row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Alternative ownership test over the same four-id row: when selector +0x1A is -1 every non-empty material id must pass the kind-filtered presence test, otherwise the selector must equal the value returned by 0x0023D078(kind,0).
evidence: Record layout matches 0x006301A4; callers Ui_UmaWindow_* and Model_FindEntryById; decompiled body returns 0 on innermost success path so polarity is untrustworthy.

name: maybe_Field_FindNpcBalloonEntryAlt
signature: BalloonEntry* maybe_Field_FindNpcBalloonEntryAlt(u32 table, u32 field, u32 arg3, u32 scratch)
summary: Resolves an NPC balloon entry and maps its quest state to a balloon type byte, falling back to the entry's own +0x14 pointer; the decompilation still uses unaff_r6 registers so the argument order is unverified.
evidence: Only caller is maybe_Ui_TrainingWindow_SelectTitleRow; body uses unaff_r6 in the argument list and the 'Alt' distinction cannot be verified.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetCursorRowState
summary: Hit-tests the list under the cursor and dispatches on the picked component's class: bag rows return Ui_BagList_GetRowState, equipment rows return a weapon-type code.
evidence: Callees Ui_Overlay_FindTargetUnderCursor, Ui_Equipment_GetWeaponTypeA, Ui_Equipment_GetWeaponType and maybe_Ui_BagList_GetRowState; caller maybe_Menu_ApplyRowColorState maps the result to colour commands, but the result is a mixed row kind/state.

name: maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8OrTrap
signature: void* maybe_Data_ResolveRelativeEntry8OrTrap(u16* key, void* group, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int manager)
summary: Resolves an entry through a relative-offset link chain, re-resolving the id through Game_GetDataManager + 0x0063CDD8 when the chain is broken, and returns the static default entry on failure.
evidence: Callees Game_GetDataManager, func_0063CDD8 and std_String_FormatInitE; callers Ui_Pane_CreateEffectForItemId, Gfx_EffectObject_Replace and Ui_Window_RefreshEffect; the exact record kind is still ambiguous.

name: maybe_Svc_Ir_CloseService
summary: Closes the shared ir:USER session: sends the 0x00020000 close command, closes the shared-memory handle, releases the session handle, unmaps shared memory and clears the open flag.
evidence: Exact inverse of 0x00122200 with the same globals (open flag 0x7B2D08, session 0x7B2D2C, shared memory 0x7F2DE0); the old Gfx_FinalizeSession name is contradicted by the 'ir:USER' literal.

name: maybe_Svc_SyncObject_DestroyB
summary: Destroys a synchronisation object: closes its kernel handle with Os_CloseHandle, then closes the remaining handle with svcCloseHandle and clears the stored handle field.
evidence: Sibling 0x00509A20 has the same shape with a different close helper and both are waited on together by the content-cache code at 0x0050A714; which primitive each object kind represents is still unknown.
